title: BEFORE the flood: Prepare
learningObjectives: PLACEHOLDER: Name the basic items of a family go-bag.
PLACEHOLDER: Choose a safe evacuation route on higher ground.

intro.situation: A strong typhoon is expected tonight. You are at GoodWheel with your sibling.
intro.goal: Pack a go-bag with the 6 most important items, then ask the staff about the safe evacuation route.

items.name: Drinking water
items.feedback: Clean water is the first thing to pack.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

items.name: Flashlight
items.feedback: A flashlight is safer than candles when the power goes out.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

items.name: Battery radio
items.feedback: A radio lets you hear official advisories without power.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

items.name: First-aid kit
items.feedback: Treat small injuries while help is far away.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

items.name: Documents in a waterproof bag
items.feedback: Keep IDs and papers dry in a sealed bag.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

items.name: Medicine
items.feedback: Bring the medicines your family needs every day.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

items.name: Game console
items.feedback: Not essential. Space in a go-bag is for survival items.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

items.name: Party balloons
items.feedback: Fun, but not useful in an emergency.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

items.name: Scented candles
items.feedback: Candles are a fire risk. Pack a flashlight instead.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

questions.objective: PLACEHOLDER: Choose a safe evacuation route.
questions.speaker: staff
questions.situation: The barangay may order an evacuation tonight. Which way should your family go?

choices.text: Along the riverbank. It is the shortest way.
choices.feedback: Rivers overflow first. Stay away from riverbanks.

choices.text: Up the road to the evacuation center on higher ground.
choices.feedback: Correct! Go to higher ground, using the route your barangay gives.

choices.text: Wait at home until the water reaches the door.
choices.feedback: Leave early, when officials tell you to. Waiting makes it harder.

questions.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

takeaways: PLACEHOLDER: Pack a go-bag before the storm comes.
PLACEHOLDER: Water, light, radio, first aid, documents, medicine.
PLACEHOLDER: Know your route to higher ground.
